user.title: AnyVac
user.description: AnyVac reads the parsed map data (robot position, cleaning path, rooms, calibration points) from your existing Roborock integration and exposes it for the AnyVac card. Set up the Roborock integration first.

data.live_position_local: Live position from the local connection

data_description.expose_legacy_mm_attributes: Adds the pre-v2 mm-space path arrays (path, mop_path, path_dry, path_wet) back onto the map sensor. The AnyVac card does not use them — it reads the pixel-space attributes instead — and they add roughly 220 KB per vacuum to every 30-second update sent to your browser. Only turn this on if you have your own automations or templates reading them.
data_description.live_position_local: While a vacuum cleans, ask it over the local connection every few seconds for its position and the newest part of its trace, so the map moves between the official integration's 30-second map updates. Uses no cloud. Turn off if your vacuum misbehaves with it.
